newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danske Bank says raises EMTN to $2.0 bln.
newsitem.headline: Danske Bank says raises EMTN to $2.0 bln.

text.p: COPENHAGEN, Feb 26 (RReuter) - Den Danske Bank said on Wednesday it was raising an existing $1.0 billion European Medium Term Note to $2.0 billion.

"The EMTN programme, which was set up in November 1995, gives the bank the possibility of exploiting favourable opportunities to issue bonds on international capital markets at short notice," Danske Bank said in a statement.

"The programme is listed on the Luxembourg Stock Exchange and can be used to take up supplementary and ordinary capital in several different currencies," it said. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
